## General Schedule

- **December 21, 2026** [Arrival Day]: Check-in opens (14:00) | Opening Ceremony (18:00) | Welcome Keynote (20:00)
- **December 22, 2026** [Day 1]: Competitions begin (09:00) | Workshops - Batch A (10:00) | Guest Lectures (11:00)
- **December 23, 2026** [Day 2]: Day 2 competitions (09:00) | Cultural Showcases (18:00) | Hackathon Night (22:00)
- **December 24, 2026** [Day 3]: Finals + Prize Distributions (12:00) | Closing Ceremony (18:00)

## Guest Speakers & Keynotes

1. **Sam Altman** (CEO, OpenAI): "The Path to Deep AGI & Cognitive Hybrids" | Dec 22, 11:00 IST | Convocation Hall
2. **Dr. Shirley Ann Jackson** (Cosmologist): "Quantum Gravity & Space-Time Engineering" | Dec 22, 14:30 IST | PC Saxena Auditorium
3. **Vitalik Buterin** (Founder, Ethereum): "Decentralized Quantum Encryption Protocols" | Dec 23, 10:00 IST | Convocation Hall
4. **Dr. Hiroshi Ishiguro** (Director, Intelligent Robotics Lab): "The Ghost in the Biomimetic Shell" | Dec 23, 15:00 IST | Gymkhana Ground Arena
5. **Demis Hassabis** (Co-founder, Google DeepMind): "Biomimetic Drug Synthesis via Deep Learning" | Dec 24, 11:30 IST | PC Saxena Auditorium
6. **Dr. Margaret Hamilton** (Founder, Hamilton Technologies): "Hyper-Reliable Software in Manned Spaceways" | Dec 24, 14:00 IST | Convocation Hall

## Exhibited Technologies

1. **Boston Dynamics Atlas Gen-2**: Hydraulically powered autonomous humanoid | Main Exhibition Hall A
2. **CERN Antimatter Trap**: Containment Penning-Malmberg magnet display | Energy Sync Labs
3. **ISRO Gaganyaan Core Module**: Manned space flight simulator cabin | Space Pavilion
4. **MIT Synth-Synapse Exoskeleton**: Biomechatronic EMG-controlled armor | Main Exhibition Hall B
5. **Tokamak H-1 Fusion Reactor**: Confining deuterium-tritium plasma at 100M°C | Energy Sync Labs
6. **ETH Zurich Holographic Eye**: Spatial light-field volumetric projects | Main Exhibition Hall A

## Competitions & Prize Pool Matrix

- **Robowar Sigma (Titan Class 120kg)**: Prize pool ₹6,00,000. Build pneumatic flippers and disc spinners.
- **Code Breach**: Prize pool ₹1,50,000. Capture-the-flag competitive programming.
- **Neural Wars (AI-03)**: Prize pool ₹2,50,000. Real-time adversarial AI models.
- **Aerobot Prime (Drones)**: Prize pool ₹1,20,000. Drone obstacle race.
- **DataVault Heist**: Prize pool ₹80,000. Fast data science extraction.
- **Space Odyssey**: Prize pool ₹2,00,000. Mars mission proposal.
